description: This source file contains the implementation of the CachedTypeResolver class, which extends TypeResolver to provide cached type resolution functionality within the Orleans.Serialization.TypeSystem namespace. The class manages type and assembly caches to optimize repetitive type lookups, utilizing concurrent dictionaries for thread safety.

classes.name: CachedTypeResolver
classes.description: A thread-safe class that caches type and assembly lookups to improve performance of type resolution in the Orleans.Serialization framework.

methods.name: GetName
methods.description: Retrieves the cached assembly name for a given Assembly instance.

methods.name: ResolveType
methods.description: Resolves a type by name, throwing an exception if not found.

methods.name: TryResolveType
methods.description: Attempts to resolve a type by name, returning a boolean indicating success.

methods.name: TryPerformUncachedTypeResolution
methods.description: Performs an uncached resolution of a type given its name, searching all loaded assemblies.

methods.name: TryGetCachedType
methods.description: Checks if a type is already cached.

methods.name: AddTypeToCache
methods.description: Adds a resolved type to the cache.

methods.name: TryPerformUncachedTypeResolution
methods.description: Attempts to resolve a type from a set of assemblies or via Type.GetType with additional resolution logic.
